resources.string: "Could not change language. Please try again."
"Incorrect or expired password. Edit the password to reconnect."
"Remove this local connection and its credentials. Desktop sessions are kept."
"Outcome unknown: return to the session, refresh and verify the records, then confirm before using Ask."
"Some desktop searches failed. Local title matching was used instead."
"Starting with Android 17, connecting to a desktop on your local network requires permission. CPA only connects to addresses you add; it does not scan for devices."
"Could not open the camera. Check the camera app and its permissions."
"Loading image, or the file is unavailable or invalid."
"Outcome unknown; automatic retries are disabled. Refresh the records and verify whether the message was sent to avoid duplicate tasks."
"No records are currently available. Also check the desktop run status."
"Verification preview: the latest 20 entries, up to 4,000 characters each. View full records on the desktop."
"A session or task may already exist. Abandoning will not delete it, and submitting again may create another session. Have you verified the result?"
"The previous result has not been verified. Submitting again is disabled."
"The most recent encrypted key saved for this gateway will be used."
"This connection is not encrypted. Credentials and content may be intercepted. Use only on a trusted network."
"Enter an http(s):// or ws(s):// gateway address."
"Enter an https:// address, or explicitly accept the risks of an http:// address."
"Discovery timed out. Check the gateway and try again."
"Gateway authentication failed. Check the API key."
"Discovery failed. Check the gateway address, key, and network."
"Wait for a successful lookup on this connection before answering. The old question is shown only for verification."
"Could not load subagents. Check the connection and try again."
"Subagent records are not loaded. Refresh to try again."
"Could not read the directory. Try again."
"Could not read the file. Check the path or try again."
"Could not read Git changes. Check the repository path, connection, or remote base branch and try again."
"Could not read the directory. The previous directory is retained. Check the path or try again."

"The operation failed or partially completed. Refresh projects and verify the desktop; it will not be retried automatically. If session ownership is uncertain, open the affected sessions and refresh them too."
"Could not load skills. Refresh to try again."
"Attachment loading was interrupted. Select the unfinished attachments again."
"Some attachments could not be read or exceed 25 MiB. Successfully loaded attachments are retained."
"The selected model does not support images. Change the model or remove the images."
"Images in one request must total no more than 25 MiB. Remove some images."
"The original message no longer exists or is queued. Refresh and verify."
"The edited run has not been confirmed to start. Your draft is retained. Refresh and verify the desktop."
"The edit was rejected. Your draft is retained. Check it before trying again."
"The edit outcome is unknown. Your draft is retained. Refresh and verify; it will not be resent automatically."
"Refresh failed. Check the connection and try again."
"Could not load branches. Refresh to try again."
"Invalid parameters or the desktop rejected the request. Your draft is retained. Check before retrying manually."
"The creation or send outcome is unknown. Your draft and target ID are retained. Verify before continuing."
"Could not confirm the target session. Check the connection and verify on the desktop. No automatic retry will occur."
"Refresh the target records and verify again."
"The previous operation outcome is unknown. Refresh and verify; no automatic retry will occur."
"This gateway desktop is already added. Edit the existing connection."
"Invalid input. Check the address and connection settings."
"The desktop rejected the request. Check before continuing."
"The remote operation outcome is unknown. Refresh and verify; no automatic retry will occur."
"Operation failed. Check the connection or local storage and try again."
"Could not save the preference. Try again."
"Could not save the code wrapping preference."
"Some branches or environments could not be checked. Refresh to try again."
"Could not load the session. Try again."
"Refresh the records successfully and verify the desktop before allowing manual sending."
"Sending failed or the outcome is unknown. Your draft and attachments are retained. Verify before acting manually."
"Invalid parameters. Check the name or model capabilities."
"Operation failed. Refresh and verify the desktop state before trying again."
"Could not refresh models and sessions. Check the connection."
"The stop request failed or its outcome is unknown. Verify the run status."
"Confirmation was interrupted; the outcome is unknown. Refresh and verify before resending."
"Lookup failed; this does not mean there is no question. Check the connection and refresh."
"Manually verified. Submitting again is a new explicit action."
"Return to the session, refresh the records, and confirm the previous operation before unlocking Ask."
"This question does not allow a custom answer."
"The desktop accepted the answer; this does not mean the agent has consumed it."
"The desktop confirmed the countdown was stopped."
"The desktop rejected the operation (false). The form is retained. Refresh and verify."

"Outcome unknown: the response was not a boolean. No automatic resend will occur. Refresh and verify the desktop and resolution records; an empty record does not prove the operation was not executed."
"Outcome unknown: the operation was cancelled. No automatic resend will occur. Refresh and verify the desktop and resolution records; an empty record does not prove the operation was not executed."
"Outcome unknown: RPC failed. No automatic resend will occur. Refresh and verify the desktop and resolution records; an empty record does not prove the operation was not executed."
"Gateway authentication failed. Check the API key."
"Could not save the client identity. Check local storage."
"Connected, but the recent gateway could not be saved. Enter it again next time."
"Could not read saved connections. Storage has not been overwritten. Check device storage and try again."
"The connection was saved, but the recent gateway could not be saved."
"Could not save connection settings. Data on disk may have changed while the screen is unchanged. Reload and verify the settings before retrying."
"The operation outcome is unknown. Refresh and verify the desktop before confirming."
